title: Collections and exhibitions
slide_intent: Teach designers to judge a reproduction by whether viewers can inspect the original work clearly and faithfully.
strategic_value: Faithful images can give varied works from the collection a shared standard of care without imposing a uniform look on the objects.
demonstration: A short selection rule accompanies a mosaic of paintings, objects, a vehicle and photographic subjects. Their colors and materials remain distinct.
practical_value: Select a high-quality scan or focused photograph that preserves the work’s character. Check quality and cropping across the complete set.

content_islands.name: Selection note
content_islands.spec: Set the title, short explanation and four selection keywords in the narrow column at left.

content_islands.name: Collection mosaic
content_islands.spec: Place individual works in a tight grid at right. Mix portraits, objects and artworks of different proportions with consistent gutters.
